scope_amendments.authorized_by: operator decision ("Авторизовать worker.rs и mcp.rs", 2026-08-28), applied by lead engineer; the builder did not amend scope itself
scope_amendments.reason: Task 4's non-login owner role makes ALTER TABLE ... OWNER TO require the ability to SET ROLE to vestrace_guarded_owner, which the runtime role deliberately lacks. server.rs, worker.rs and mcp.rs each call store.migrate() at startup, so under the runtime role every one of them refuses to boot with 'database migrations are unavailable'. Pointing only the Compose migrate service at the bootstrap identity was not sufficient: the lead engineer's compose smoke got past migration and then failed with the server and worker exiting 1 for this reason. store.migrations_are_compatible() already exists and is already called immediately after migrate(); it reads _sqlx_migrations and compares it to the embedded MIGRATOR, needs only SELECT, and preserves the fail-closed refusal to start against a stale schema. Removing the DDL call from the three runtime composition roots is therefore the smallest correct fix, and it strengthens Task 4 by removing DDL from the restricted role entirely. server.rs was already in scope; worker.rs and mcp.rs were not.
scope_amendments.preservation_note: mcp.rs carries unrelated uncommitted work; only the startup migration call may change there, and its pre-P02 digest remains recorded in dirty_files. worker.rs was clean at capture.
scope_amendments.not_amended: The administrative migrate command in crates/vestrace-cli/src/commands/migrate.rs keeps applying migrations and is deliberately left out of scope; it is the path that is supposed to perform DDL.

scope_amendments.reason: Two consequences of moving DDL off the runtime role. First, crates/vestrace-cli/src/commands/conformance.rs calls store.migrate() in four places through the same config.database the server uses, so under a P02-provisioned database the qualification tooling - the tooling that later produces release evidence - fails with the same SET ROLE refusal; two of those four call sites have no compatibility gate at all. Second, once an administrative migrator owns _sqlx_migrations the runtime role can no longer even SELECT it, so migrations_are_compatible() fails closed with SQLSTATE 42501, observed directly by the builder. migrations/0175 grants the runtime role SELECT on that table and nothing else, forward-only because 0166-0174 have now actually been applied through the deployment path and must not be altered. crates/vestrace-cli/tests/runtime_schema_gate.rs is a new clean file, chosen deliberately over editing the dirty out-of-scope command_contract.rs.
scope_amendments.preservation_note: conformance.rs carries unrelated uncommitted work; only the startup migration handling may change there, and its pre-P02 digest remains recorded in dirty_files. The migration and the CLI test are new files.

scope_amendments.reason: The plan's global constraint requires new crash boundaries to be variants of the existing EffectFaultPoint rather than a forked harness, and the independent review recorded the separate IntentFaultPoint as a BLOCKER contradiction. Honouring the letter of the plan reaches further than the two files the deviation touched: EffectFaultPoint is consumed by the application fault runtime's parse and name functions, by the fault suite and fault evidence types, by the v1 release gate CLI test, and by two fault-scenario contract tests. All seven were outside the captured scope. The lead engineer disclosed before proceeding that this trades a guarantee the type system gives for free - an intent boundary cannot be handed to the effect runtime because they are different types - for refusal logic that must now be written and tested inside release-critical code, and the operator confirmed with that cost stated.
scope_amendments.invariants_that_must_not_move: EffectFaultPoint::required_points() stays [Self; 5] and keeps returning exactly the five external-effect boundaries, so the fault suite, evaluate_fault_suite, the v1 release gate, child_points and output_contract all observe an unchanged count. The harness refusals stay exactly as strict and keep exiting 2, including an effect boundary name given to an intent scenario and the reverse.
